conclusions.text: The 24 declared subjects resolve one-to-one against current geography records and the pinned predecessor inventory; this establishes scope identity only.
Nine ONSDI administrative districts join one-to-one by normalized exact name to the nine Mauritius Island district records; area differences are triage, not legal validation.
Census, park points, MSP map polygons, and official descriptions do not establish complete physical island, reef, or settlement inventories.

St Brandon membership, Agaléga cross-source physical membership, Seychelles Other Islands component crosswalk, exact Litto3D target-island footprints, and current complete settlement coverage remain unresolved.

The captured official Shom catalog lists 80 Eparses, 192 Mayotte and 134 Reunion package tiles. Their geographic metadata bounding boxes intersect the current named Atlas feature polygons in 10, 38 and 123 cases, respectively. Three current Bassas da India components have no listed package bbox within 1 km. These catalog-envelope comparisons do not establish raster pixel coverage, physical island absence, coastline accuracy, or completeness.

The searched official Seychelles sources still do not provide a licensed island-level source-to-region membership crosswalk or a licensed complete geocoded settlement point layer; the exact Other Islands member set and region-parent discrepancies remain open.
